summary: Iteration 6 backend verification — updated fantavoto rules. Full pytest regression: 88/88 PASSED in ~10s against the public preview URL. All 8 tests in test_fantavoto_rules.py pass (gol_vittoria +1, gol_pareggio +0.5, portiere gol_subiti -1 each, portiere rigore_parato +3, non-portiere ignores gol_subiti and rigore_parato, complex striker scenario). All 6 formula scenarios from the review request validated directly against server.fantavoto_from_vote (P v6/3sub=3.0, P v6/1sub/1par=8.0, A v7/1gol/1vittoria=11.0, A v7/1gol/1pareggio=10.5, non-P gol_subiti/rigore_parato ignored). Non-regression: auth, players/teams, leagues, lineups, bench validation, substitutions, /system endpoints, players sync all still green. Persistence path (submit_votes) writes all 3 new fields plus fantavoto to the votes doc (server.py:822-837). Both api-football sync paths (_sync_matchday_votes_global L458, sync_votes_from_api L938) map penalty.saved → rigore_parato and default gol_vittoria/gol_pareggio to 0 as specified. No frontend testing performed (backend-only review request).
critical_code_review_comments: fantavoto_from_vote (server.py:167-183) implementation matches the specified formula exactly, including new gol_vittoria (+1), gol_pareggio (+0.5), portiere gol_subiti (-1 per gol, previously per 2), and rigore_parato (+3 for P).
VoteIn model (server.py:128-141) correctly declares the 3 new optional fields with default 0, so existing clients that do not send them stay backward-compatible.
submit_votes (server.py:806-842) persists rigore_parato, gol_vittoria, gol_pareggio alongside fantavoto — verified via test_15 which asserts formula match end-to-end.
Both sync paths correctly source rigore_parato from api-football penalty.saved and default the manual bonuses to 0, as specified.
Minor (non-blocking): FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — consider migrating to lifespan handlers in a future cleanup pass (not required for this iteration).
